newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta closes above lows as EMU jitters recede.
newsitem.headline: Peseta closes above lows as EMU jitters recede.

text.p: The peseta closed on Monday above its low of the session of 84.78 per mark despite the euro uncertainty unleashed by the French position over the stability pact.
"The peseta rebounded well. It doesn't seem short-term that it is going to pass support at 84.80/85.00," a dealer said.
On balance, French reticence about the stability pact was not seen derailing the European economic and monetary union and markets expected a compromise to be reached.
At 1515 GMT, the peseta was trading at 84.65/68, after late Friday rates of 84.57/59.
